definitions.full: H2927. telal [ טְלַל ] verb Haph`el have shade ( ᵑ7 Syriac; see Biblical Hebrew III. [ צָלַל ]); — Imperfect 3feminine singular תַּטְלֵל Dan 4:9 (beasts under tree).
